name: [UPD🏸] Racket Rivals
desc:
🎾RACKET RIVALS is a fast paced 3v3 Racket Game, with abilities, champions, a shuttle and chaos! This game is a combination of badminton, tennis, squash and volleyball, all rolled into one! 

CONTROLS:
SWING –  Left Click
POWER SWING – (Hold) Left Click
SET – E
DASH - Q
ABILITY - 1
AWAKENING - 2
EMOTES - V
BUBBLES - B

Unlock spirits with awesome abilities, summon powerful rackets, and get awakenings that give you crazy ultimates!

Made with ❤️ by Small World Games
